items.title: 4estGimp — What The Donated File Actually Is
items.content:
4estGimp personally donated a PDF export of their real, personal Mod Organizer 2 (MO2) install spreadsheet — 400 pages, each one a screenshot-style image of one section of a large categorized mod list (not extractable text; the PDF is 400 embedded page images from a Zoho Sheet export). Verified directly by viewing a representative sample of the page images across the full document.

This is 4estGimp's OWN load order, organized top-to-bottom in install order under bold category headers, with a 'Mod' column and an 'Archive Link'/version column. Observed real top-level categories include: 01. Work (baseline ESM cleaning + UFO4P + performance texture sets), UI (FallUI suite, HUDFramework, item sorters), Quests (companion and quest mods, The Fens Sheriff's Department, Tales from the Commonwealth), Weapons (a large WWII/Soviet-era replacer collection built on AnotherOne's weapon mods), Armor (the CROSS_ armor series), Power Armor (a very large section covering nearly a dozen popular power armor mods), Factions/NPCs (Militarized Minutemen, Synth Overhaul, Railroad Expansion), Settlements (Better Settlers, Uncapped Settlement Surplus, Transfer Settlements, Basement Living, CWSS Redux, Better Stores/Vendor Stalls, Manufacturing Extended), a large merged Music/Audio section, and a Visuals section (True Storms, Darker Nights, Clarity, WET).

This is a personal curated load order shared as a reference, not a searchable conflict-lookup database — there is no 'search by mod name to find your conflict' mechanism in the file itself; it's simply 4estGimp's own real, working modlist made public.

**CREDIT: This is 4estGimp's real, personal work, donated directly to Mossy. Endorse their patches on Nexus Mods.**

items.title: 4estGimp — Real Patch-Authoring Pattern: ESL-Compact + Complex-Sorter INNR ini
items.content:
The single most useful, teachable pattern in 4estGimp's donated load order, confirmed by its repetition across dozens of real rows spanning the Weapons, Armor, and Power Armor sections: for nearly every popular third-party mod they use, 4estGimp maintains their OWN pair of small compatibility files rather than one-off patches:

1. An ESL-compacted / cleaned 'Edit' or 'Compacted' version of the mod's plugin (e.g. '4estGimp - T-51C Power Armor Compacted', '4estGimp - A1 PPS-43 Edit', '4estGimp - Suomi KP-31 Edit').
2. A 'CIS INNR ini' file — a Complex Item Sorter (Complex Sorter framework) injector-ini patch that hooks the mod's new items into 4estGimp's own crafting/inventory sort categories (e.g. '4estGimp - T51C AirForce PA CIS INNR ini', '4estGimp - CROSS_TechMask_INNR_ini_CS1.9', '4estGimp - Vault Tec PA CIS INNR ini').

This two-file pattern repeats for essentially every mod in the Power Armor section (T-51C, Vault Tec, Midwest Power Armor Evolution, Excavator, Ultracite, Red Shift, T65, HellCat, Enclave, Bastion-Soviet, MidWest Revolution) and across the WWII/Soviet weapon replacer collection (PPS-43, Suomi KP-31, PPSh-41, Sten MkII, Vargo 52, and more).

The teaching value: this is a real example of how a prolific, professional patch author scales compatibility maintenance across a huge, evolving mod list — by maintaining a REPEATABLE per-mod template (compact + sorter-injection) instead of writing bespoke one-off patches each time. This is directly relevant to anyone building a FOMOD-based compatibility patch or maintaining Complex Sorter/Complex Item Sorter categories across their own mod collection.

**CREDIT: This workflow and all named patches are 4estGimp's own real work.**

items.title: 4estGimp — Real Power Armor Section: Full Mod Coverage
items.content:
4estGimp's donated load order's Power Armor section is the largest single category observed, covering nearly a dozen popular power armor mods each with a 'Compacted'/'Edit' plugin plus a 'CIS INNR ini' patch by 4estGimp (all edits versioned 0.95). Real mods covered, observed directly: T-51C Power Armor (+ AirForce variant), Vault Tec Power Armor (v1.1, + a separate 'Vault Tec PA 2k' texture mod v1.0), Midwest Power Armor Evolution (v1.2, + a BoS Knight Replacer edit, + Midwest Power Armor UHD v1.1), Excavator Power Armor (v A-v3.3), Ultracite Power Armor (v1.3, + a 'Crafting FIX - ESL' patch), Red Shift PA (v1), T 65 Power Armor (v1), HellCat Power Armor (v1.2, + a Hellcat Power Armor FIX), Enclave Power Armor (v1, as an 'Enclave Gear Pack'), Bastion - Soviet Power Armor (v1, + an ESL edit), and MidWest Power Armor Revolution (v1, + a separate 'dp- Midwest T Revolution HD' texture mod v1).

This confirms 4estGimp maintains ESL-compaction + sorter-injection compatibility across essentially the entire popular FO4 power armor mod ecosystem as of this donation.

**CREDIT: All 4estGimp-authored patches listed are their own real work.**
